case.must_observe.1.rationale: Links the evidenced E-14 enabled-state exception to conditional unauthorized-access and repeat-delay scenarios, objectives/impacts, documented protections and unverified safeguards. Bounds evidence to one account/time and explicitly avoids assuming continuous enablement or actual misuse/loss.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: Provides conditional interim proposals for authorized status confirmation, disablement or approved substitute blocking, evidence preservation and deadline tracking; distinguishes proposals from current controls and requests authorized owners/closure evidence.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Keeps probability, loss, rating method, appetite and horizon Not provided; no invented scores or certainty that an incident occurred/will occur. Urgency follows an evidenced policy-state mismatch rather than a fabricated rating.

limitations: Reviewer authored fixture/skill but not the answering run; not third-party assurance.
Single synthetic observation, not live account investigation or population-wide OE.
Exact model identifier unavailable; executor-maintained trace retains quoting/date-format recovery and reference-read truncation recovery.
